evidence: roberts_2022_source_data.xlsx: all 14 small sheets returned TABLE_BOUNDARIES_REQUIRED under the previous splitter (side-by-side tables, title and dose rows above headers, side footnotes).

design.table_split: Precedence: explicit range plan bound to file sha256, Excel table definitions, DOI source anchors, DC-split. DC-split proposes tables (title, range, header_row) and note blocks (TITLE, DESCRIPTION, FOOTNOTE, STATISTICS, OTHER, applies_to). Host code checks bounds, non-empty header rows inside the range, overlaps, note links and that every non-empty cell is covered; otherwise the sheet stays UNASSIGNED with TABLE_SPLIT_INVALID (HUMAN_REVIEW). Oversized sheets give TABLE_SPLIT_TOO_LARGE. A failed explicit plan gives TABLE_RANGE_PLAN_INVALID and is never replaced by a model split.
design.labels: role plus additional_roles; columns {header, meaning, unit, evidence} with units as written and no conversion. Page merge: role or category conflict becomes MIXED, other field conflicts NOT_FOUND, column conflicts meaning OTHER and unit NOT_FOUND, each with a LABEL_CONFLICT finding. Condition triggers match any of an item's roles; MIXED stays UNDETERMINED.
design.review_split: On DATA_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE, one DC-review per task (its requirements, items first used by it, criterion plans, evidence and condition rows) plus one for items no task uses and the G008 items due before QC. Shared checks keep the strictest decision with reasons joined by scope; review.json lists every part with its request hash and decision.
